# 📢 Changelog v2.1 → v2.5
### May 2026
## 💫  New Features
### 🌟 Major Additions:
> • **Collaborative Tagging** — Writers can submit tags to add to a story, and the tag will be posted to the story thread with reaction emojis for others to vote on the tag. Story creators and admins can review and approve/reject them from the `/story manage` panel.
> • **Slow Mode** — A more laid-back no-timer story mode. Like Normal Mode, turns have their own threads, but there's no timeout so turns only end only when finalized or skipped. A reminder that repeats every X hours can be configured to keep writers on track.

### ✨ Minor Additions:
> • **Story Reopening** — Closed stories can be reopened from `/story manage`.
> • **Draft Preservation** — When a Normal mode turn ends without being finalized (skip or timeout), any draft content in the turn threads can be kept for up to 24 hours so writers can access their drafts later.

## 🛠️ Improvements
> • **Story Management Panel Refined** — *All* the story settings are now accessible to the story creator and admins via one control panel found by typing `/story manage`: title, order, turn length, story join status, thread privacy, pause/resume/reopen story, set or edit metadata, delete or restore entries, and take various turn actions all in one place.  Admins have a control panel for user management via `/storyadmin user`.
> • **Help System Refactor** - The `/story help` pages now load in a select menu Table of Contents with pages on the bot Overview, Your Stories & Turns, Creating a Story, Reading & Editing, Managing a Story, and Writer and Admin Command References.  Help pages repost to the Hub server's <#1499454495044927739> forum when updated so you can read them all here as well!
